cohort: All patients undergoing caesarean section after attaining term and at full dilatation of cervix.
finding: The study found that primigravida aged 21-25 years constituted the majority undergoing second stage caesarean section, which was associated with high rates of maternal (87.2%) and fetal (87.2%) complications, notably post-partum haemorrhage and birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: The study identified high rates of maternal (87.2%) and fetal (87.2%) complications, such as post-partum haemorrhage and birth asphyxia, associated with second stage caesarean sections.
